what_this_is: the architect's explicit GO for the J12 closed-loop qualification. It is ADDITIVE: it neither modifies nor supersedes the readiness authorization or the readiness report, both of which remain immutable evidence of what was proposed and reviewed.
does_not_modify: any J0-J11 artefact, July source, report or production configuration

approval.prior_state: the readiness authorization declares execution_permitted_now false; THIS record is the explicit GO that lifts it, without editing that file

pinned_by: the architect, in the GO message, hash by hash
on_any_hash_mismatch: DO NOT EXECUTE. The GO covers exactly these four files and nothing else.

matrix.order_is_frozen: A, B, C, D, E, F, sequential

authorised_execution.no_variant: no flag may be added, removed or altered
authorised_execution.capture_is_outside_the_leaf: stdout, stderr and the exit code are captured into an ADDITIVE directory that is not the transactional leaf, so capture can never disturb the atomic commit
authorised_execution.capture_is_redirection_only: it cannot cause a second attempt

non_mutating_checks: the full selftest must be PASS
py_compile on the runner and the test
the preflight must be GO with no blockers and with torch and ray absent from sys.modules
no J12 leaf, no lock, no staging, no sentinel

module_load_smoke_test.why: ray's checkpoint loader catches EVERY exception while unpickling class_and_ctor_args.pkl and silently returns a weightless base RLModule. A rollout against an empty network would produce evidence about nothing.
must_prove: the loaded class is exactly AsymmetricActorCriticTorchRLModule
it holds exactly the ten actor keys
every tensor is bit-identical to the pinned module_state.pkl

required_before_execution.on_any_failure: DO NOT EXECUTE J12. Stop and report with the evidence.

outcome_policy.behavioural_fail: the leaf IS COMMITTED with the full six-cell evidence, the post-commit verification passes, verdict FAIL, exit non-zero. PRESERVE, report, STOP. No retry.
outcome_policy.telemetry_invalid: verdict INVALID - a statement about the evidence, never about the gait. PRESERVE, report, STOP.
outcome_policy.post_commit_verification_failure: the leaf is preserved, marked TECHNICAL_INVALID, commit_verification pass false. PRESERVE, report, STOP.
outcome_policy.technical_error: NO leaf committed; staging and lock removed. STOP and report.
outcome_policy.pass: the leaf is committed, commit_verification pass true, the marker is gone, verdict PASS, exit 0. PRESERVE, report, hand back.

a_pass_does_not_authorise: the critic warm-up, which is explicitly NOT to be started
any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin

after_the_run.inspect: the leaf, the receipt, commit_verification and all six cell results
after_the_run.then: STOP for the architect's independent review

penetration_reading.hard_binding: > 0.028 m is the ONLY binding bar; exactly 0.028 PASSES
